item.title: NASA’s Hubble reveals the largest chaotic birthplace of planets
item.description: Astronomers using NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope have imaged the largest protoplanetary disk ever observed circling a young star. For the first time in visible light, Hubble has revealed the disk is unexpectedly chaotic and turbulent, with wisps of material stretching much farther above and below the disk than astronomers have seen in any similar system. item.title: Run Python in browsers with Pyodide and WebAssembly
item.description: Pyodide compiles CPython to WebAssembly, letting developers run full Python directly in the browser without servers or installations. There’s only one way to bring Python’s full functionality (really no compromises) to the browser: Pyodide.
